title: Confit Byaldi with Piperade and Slow-Baked Vegetable Spiral
summary: Thin slices of courgette, aubergine and tomato are coiled over a slow-cooked pepper and tomato piperade, then baked until tender for an elegant layered dish.

ingredients.item: red pepper, seeds and ribs removed
yellow pepper, seeds and ribs removed
orange pepper, seeds and ribs removed
tomatoes, peeled, seeded and finely diced, juices kept
fine sea salt or table salt
long slim aubergine (about 130 g), sliced 1.5 mm thick
yellow courgette (about 130 g), sliced 1.5 mm thick
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Oven 230°C, roast the pepper halves cut side down until the skins loosen, about 15 min, then cover, cool, peel and chop finely.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Cook 2 tbsp oil, 1 tsp garlic and 70 g onion on low until very soft but not coloured, 8 min.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the 340 g diced tomatoes with their juices, thyme, parsley and bay leaf and simmer on low until very soft and nearly dry, 10 min.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the peppers, cook for 2-3 min, season with ¼ tsp salt and discard the herbs, then spread most of it in the ovenproof pan, keeping 1 tbsp aside.

steps.title: Arrange
steps.text: Oven down to 140°C; lay a central line of alternating courgette, aubergine, yellow courgette and tomato slices, then spiral the rest tightly around it, mounding toward the middle.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Mix ½ tsp garlic, 2 tsp oil, thyme, ¼ tsp salt and ⅛ tsp pepper and sprinkle over the vegetables.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover tightly with foil and bake until tender to a knife, about 2 h, then uncover and bake for 30 min more.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Mix the reserved piperade with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp balsamic vinegar and the herbs.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Grill briefly until lightly browned, cut into quarters and fan out on plates with the dressing spooned around.

tips: Slice the vegetables as thinly and evenly as possible so the spiral holds its shape.
Keep the vegetables covered tightly with foil for most of the baking time to stop them drying out.
Reduce any excess liquid on the hob before serving for a cleaner-looking plate.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days and reheat gently in the oven until warmed through before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
